definitions.gloss: regional revitalization; local revitalization; regional renewal
definitions.explanation: Government policy and efforts aimed at revitalizing rural and regional areas of Japan facing population decline and economic stagnation.

examples.japanese: {地方創生|ちほうそうせい}が{国|くに}の{重要|じゅうよう}な{課題|かだい}になっている。
examples.english: Regional revitalization has become an important national issue.

examples.japanese: {地方創生|ちほうそうせい}のために、{若者|わかもの}の{移住|いじゅう}を{促進|そくしん}している。
examples.english: To revitalize the regions, they are promoting migration of young people.

examples.japanese: {観光|かんこう}を{活用|かつよう}した{地方創生|ちほうそうせい}の{取|と}り{組|く}みが{全国|ぜんこく}で{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: Efforts at regional revitalization through tourism are spreading across the country.

notes:
Compound of {地方|ちほう} (region, locality) + {創生|そうせい} (creation, genesis). A key policy term in Japan since 2014 when the government established the {まち・ひと・しごと創生本部|そうせいほんぶ} (Headquarters for Overcoming Population Decline and Vitalizing Local Economy).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地方創生|ちほうそうせい}{政策|せいさく}: regional revitalization policy
- {地方創生|ちほうそうせい}に{取|と}り{組|く}む: to work on regional revitalization
- {地方創生|ちほうそうせい}{交付金|こうふきん}: regional revitalization grant

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's regional areas face {過疎化|かそか} (depopulation) as young people move to {東京|とうきょう} and other major cities. {地方創生|ちほうそうせい} aims to reverse this trend through job creation, tourism development, and incentives for relocation to rural areas.

RELATED WORDS:
- {過疎|かそ}: depopulation (of rural areas)
- {町興|まちおこ}し: town revitalization — a grassroots, community-level effort
- {地域活性化|ちいきかっせいか}: regional activation — similar concept, more general term
